description:
Job Summary 
 Synechron is seeking a Technical Developer with 4–7 years of experience to design, develop, test, deploy, and support technology solutions. The role will work with cross-functional teams to understand technology requirements, prepare technical specifications, develop software, and contribute to code quality and maintainability.
 The position supports business objectives by delivering reliable software solutions, applying Agile and SDLC practices, resolving technical issues, and evaluating opportunities to use mobile, cloud, IoT, and blockchain technologies.
 
 
 Software Requirements 
 Required 
 Strong technical understanding of at least one of the following technology platforms: mobile, cloud, IoT, or blockchain.

 Knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.

 Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Node.js.

 Experience with Agile and Scrum development practices.

 Experience using Git, JIRA, and Confluence in software development projects.

 Ability to write, test, deploy, and support software solutions.

 Experience preparing technical specifications and detailed documentation for new features and enhancements.

 Experience participating in code reviews and providing feedback to improve code quality and maintainability.

 Experience collaborating with testing teams to validate software solutions against quality standards.

 Ability to provide technical support to team members and contribute to the resolution of technical issues.

 
 Preferred 
 Experience working with more than one of the following technology areas: mobile, cloud, IoT, or blockchain.

 Experience with current, project-supported versions of Java, Python, or Node.js.

 Familiarity with automated testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and deployment practices.

 Experience working with technology trends and assessing their applicability to existing solutions.

 Familiarity with application programming interfaces, integrations, distributed systems, or cloud-native solutions.

 Experience supporting software solutions with performance, scalability, security, or sustainability requirements.

 
 
 Overall Responsibilities 
 Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand technology requirements and design solutions that meet business needs.

 Develop technical specifications, design details, and comprehensive documentation for new features and enhancements.

 Write, test, deploy, and maintain software solutions in accordance with approved requirements and development practices.

 Stay current with the latest technology trends and advancements and suggest ways to incorporate relevant technologies into existing solutions.

 Conduct code reviews to support code quality, maintainability, consistency, and alignment with documented requirements.

 Participate in the resolution of technical issues and provide technical support to team members.

 Collaborate with the testing team to ensure software solutions are thoroughly tested and meet defined quality standards.

 Contribute to delivery outcomes by completing assigned work within agreed timelines, resolving defects, maintaining documentation, and supporting reliable releases.

 Identify opportunities to improve development processes, solution performance, operational efficiency, and responsible use of technology resources.

 Communicate technical progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to relevant stakeholders.

 
 
 Technical Skills (By Category) 
 
 Programming Languages 
 Essential 
 Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Node.js.

 Ability to write maintainable, testable, and deployable code.

 Ability to review code and provide constructive feedback during code review activities.

 
 Preferred 
 Working knowledge of two or more programming languages.

 Experience using Java, Python, or Node.js for application development, automation, integrations, or technical support.

 
 
 Databases/Data Management 
 Essential 
 Understanding of data requirements, data flows, and data handling within software solutions.

 Ability to work with development and testing teams to validate data-related functionality.

 
 Preferred 
 Familiarity with relational or non-relational databases.

 Knowledge of SQL, data structures, data validation, indexing, and database performance considerations.

 Experience supporting applications that process structured or unstructured data.

 
 
 Cloud Technologies 
 Essential 
 Strong understanding of cloud technology platforms.

 Knowledge of cloud-based application environments, services, infrastructure, and deployment considerations.

 Ability to understand cloud requirements and collaborate with technical teams on cloud-based solutions.

 
 Preferred 
 Experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications in cloud environments.

 Familiarity with cloud scalability, availability, security, monitoring, and cost considerations.

 Experience with cloud-native development or managed cloud services.

 
 
 Frameworks and Libraries 
 Essential 
 Ability to work with frameworks and libraries relevant to the selected programming language and technology platform.

 Understanding of how frameworks and libraries support application functionality, maintainability, testing, and integration.

 
 Preferred 
 Experience with frameworks and libraries used in Java, Python, Node.js, mobile, cloud, IoT, or blockchain solutions.

 Familiarity with API-based, service-oriented, or event-driven application designs.

 Experience using frameworks that support automated testing, integration, or deployment.

 
 
 Development Tools and Methodologies 
 Essential 
 Knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC).

 Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

 Experience using Git, JIRA, and Confluence.

 Experience participating in daily stand-ups, project planning sessions, code reviews, testing, deployment, and technical issue resolution.

 Ability to prepare and maintain technical specifications, development documentation, issue records, and delivery updates.

 
 Preferred 
 Experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, and release management.

 Familiarity with Agile practices such as backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

 Experience with deployment automation, version control workflows, and development quality controls.

 
 
 Security Protocols 
 Essential 
 Awareness of secure software development, access control, data protection, and application security requirements.

 Ability to identify and communicate security-related considerations during design, development, testing, and deployment.

 Understanding of the importance of protecting application code, credentials, interfaces, and data.

 
 Preferred 
 Familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, secure APIs, and vulnerability remediation.

 Experience incorporating security checks into development and deployment processes.

 
 
 Experience Requirements 
 4–7 years of professional experience in software development or a related technical development role.

 Experience developing software solutions with a focus on mobile, cloud, IoT, blockchain, or other relevant technology platforms.

 Experience with software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, Scrum, Git, JIRA, and Confluence.

 Experience writing, testing, deploying, and supporting software solutions.

 Experience working with cross-functional teams and participating in code reviews.

 Experience preparing technical specifications and detailed documentation for new features and enhancements.

 Experience supporting technical issue resolution and collaborating with testing teams to meet software quality standards.

 Experience in financial services, technology, consulting, or other complex software development environments is preferred.

 Candidates may qualify through an equivalent combination of relevant software development, platform engineering, application support, or technology implementation experience.

 
 
 Day-to-Day Activities 
 Participate in daily stand-up meetings, project planning sessions, requirements discussions, and other Agile delivery activities.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and technology requirements, design solutions, and prepare technical specifications.

 Write, test, review, deploy, and support software solutions while maintaining required technical documentation.

 Provide technical input within assigned responsibilities, resolve or escalate issues, support team members, and communicate delivery risks and dependencies.

 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

 Equivalent professional experience in software development, technology implementation, or application engineering may be considered.

 Relevant certifications in software development, Agile, Scrum, cloud technology, or related technical disciplines are preferred but not mandatory.

 Complete role-relevant training in SDLC, Agile methodologies, programming, testing, deployment, and applicable technology platforms.

 Maintain continuous professional development by keeping current with technology trends, development practices, tools, and relevant technical training.

 
 
 Professional Competencies 
 Apply analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and root-cause analysis to address technical challenges.

 Work effectively as part of a cross-functional team, contribute to code reviews, and support shared delivery objectives.

 Communicate technical information, requirements, progress, risks, and issues clearly in written and verbal formats.

 Adapt to new technologies, changing requirements, evolving project priorities, and different development environments.

 Evaluate emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve solution quality, efficiency, maintainability, and responsible resource use.

 Take initiative, prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and complete deliverables within agreed timelines.

 
 
 S​ YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT 
 
 Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more. 
 
 All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law .
 
 Candidate Application Notice
